blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Style transfer lacks a reliable evaluation standard: ground truth is inherently ill-defined, and existing automatic metrics often fail to reflect human preference. This paper introduces ASTRA (Assessment of Style TRansfer Algorithms) , an approach for automatic evaluation of style transfer algorithms; it contains two components, ASTRA-Data and ASTRA-Score . ASTRA-Data consists of a benchmark image set of content and style references, a collection of style transfer results generated on the benchmark set, and user study data capturing human judgements through a two-stage pairwise comparison protocol. From these annotations, we derive ranking-based ground truth for content preservation, style fidelity, and overall preference. Based on ASTRA-Data, we construct ASTRA-Score, a learnt evaluator that predicts preference-aligned scores from content-style-stylization image triplets, enabling automatic and scalable evaluation of new models applied to the benchmark set. Experimental results demonstrate that ASTRA-Score achieves substantially higher correlation with human rankings compared to prior metrics. Overall, ASTRA establishes a robust mechanism for standardised evaluation of style transfer methods. \ccsdesc [500]Computing methodologies Non-photorealistic rendering \ccsdesc [300]Computing methodologies Image-based rendering \ccsdesc [100]Human-centered computing Visualization design and evaluation methods \printccsdesc

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Style transfer aims to generate an image that preserves the content of one image while adopting the style of another [ JSO∗01 ] .
The field has evolved from low-level image processing [ RL10 , LR12 , RL13 , RL15 , RWW∗17 ] to modern neural style transfer (NST) methods [ GEB16 , LLH∗21 , HB17 , PL19 , DTD∗22 ] and has enabled a wide range of applications, including artistic image generation [ GLK∗17 , WYZ∗25 ] , photo editing [ HB17 ] , semantic segmentation [ ZZL∗22 ] , and data augmentation for downstream vision tasks [ JAB∗19 ] .
blocks.zh:
样式传输旨在生成一个图像,既保留一个图像的内容,又采用另一个图像的样式[JSO_01].
该领域从低级图像处理[RL10,LR12,RL13,RL15,RWW*17]演变为现代神经风格转移(NST)方法[GEB16,LLH*21,HB17,PL19,DTD*22],并实现了广泛的应用,包括艺术图像生成[GLK*17,WYZ*25],图片编辑[HB17],语义分区[ZZL*22],以及下游视觉任务的数据增强[JAB*19].

blocks.en:
Evaluating stylisation quality is fundamentally challenging [ RLM∗22 ] , yet
reliable evaluation is vital to advancing style transfer research.
Style transfer lacks well - defined ground truth; in some cases, there are multiple perceptually valid outputs for a single content–style pair,
while in others, it is not clear what if any output would qualify.
Consequently, evaluation is intrinsically ill - posed [ RLM∗22 , MR17 ] . Although metrics have progressed from low - level similarity measures to high - level representations [ GEB16 , HRU∗17 , ZIE∗18 , WO22 ] , pretrained vision and vision - language models [ DBK∗20 , CTM∗21 , BBC∗23 ] still treat many legitimate stylistic transformations as errors. Artistic styles often involve structural abstraction or reconfiguration [ KSM∗19 ] , and in such cases, existing metrics are not reliable indicators. User studies remain the de facto standard [ LSZ∗25 , GSL∗25 ] despite their cost, limited scalability, and poor reproducibility [ BHZ∗23 ] .
blocks.zh:
评估造型质量具有根本挑战性[RLM*22],然而,
可靠的评价对于推进风格转移研究至关重要。
样式转移缺乏明确的地面真理;在某些情况下,单一内容-样式对齐有多种概念上有效的输出,
在另一些情况下,还不清楚是否有任何产出符合条件。
因此,评价存在内在的缺陷 -- -- [RLM*22,MR17]。 虽然衡量标准从低-水平相似度衡量到高-水平表示[GEB16,HRU*17,ZIE*18,WO22],预先训练的视觉和视觉——语言模型[DBK*20,CTM*21,BBC*23]仍然将许多合法的造型转变视为错误. 艺术风格往往涉及结构抽象或重组[KSM*19],在这种情况下,现有的衡量标准不是可靠的指标. 用户研究仍然是事实上的标准[LSZ*25,GSL*25],尽管其成本高,可扩展性有限,可复制性差[BHZ*23].

blocks.en:
Evaluation is further constrained by weakly standardised test data. Early work relied on a few handpicked examples [ GEB16 ] , while later studies drew from general - purpose datasets
that were not intended for stylisation assessment. More systematic benchmarks have been proposed [ MR17 , RWW∗17 , RLM∗22 , CSC∗22 , RGC∗24 ] , but typically provide image collections without assessment protocols. In summary, the field still lacks standardised, perceptually aligned frameworks for evaluating artistic style transfer.
blocks.zh:
标准化测试数据薄弱,进一步限制了评价。 早期工作依靠一些手摘的例子[GEB16],而后来的研究则取自一般目的数据集
用于分层化评估。 提出了更系统化的基准[MR17、RWW*17、RLM*22、CSC*22、RGC*24]],但通常提供没有评估协议的图像收集。 总而言之,该领域仍然缺乏评价艺术风格转让的标准化、概念一致的框架。

blocks.en:
This paper advances style transfer evaluation by presenting ASTRA, Assessment of Style TRansfer Algorithms .
ASTRA contains both a benchmark dataset (ASTRA-Data, a curated dataset of style and content images) and an automated evaluation protocol (ASTRA-Score, a trained network that can estimate style transfer performance on the benchmark set). This combined benchmark and automated assessment constitutes a flexible tool for evaluating style transfer algorithms: practitioners can apply their proposed process to all combinations of style and content images in the benchmark, and use ASTRA-Score to generate numerical evaluations for each result image. These individual scores can either be aggregated or examined independently to discern particular strengths and weaknesses with respect to the benchmark coverage.
blocks.zh:
本文通过介绍 ASTRA, Style TRansfer 算法评估来推进风格转移评价 。
ASTRA既包含一个基准数据集(ASTRA-Data,一个风格和内容图像的整理数据集),也包含一个自动评价协议(ASTRA-Score,一个训练有素的网络,可以在基准集上估计样式传输性能). 这种合并的基准和自动化评估是评价样式传输算法的灵活工具:从业者可以将其拟议流程应用于基准中样式和内容图像的所有组合,并使用ASTRA-Score为每个结果图像生成数值评价. 这些个人得分可以加以汇总,也可以独立审查,以辨别基准覆盖面的具体优缺点。

blocks.en: To construct this framework, we assembled a diverse collection of painterly style images capturing a representative range of historical practices and visual elements, alongside a carefully selected set of content images. By combining these with a group of influential and varied style transfer algorithms, we produced a comprehensive set of style-content-algorithm triples, yielding output result images for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了构建这一框架,我们收集了各种绘画风格的图像,收集了具有代表性的一系列历史实践和视觉要素,并精心挑选了一套内容图像。 通过将这些组合与一批有影响力和多样的风格转移算法相结合,我们产生了一套全面的风格-内容-算法三重体,产生输出结果图像以供评价.

blocks.en: These result images provided the raw material for a large-scale user study using a two-alternative-forced-choice design. Subjects evaluated pairs based on three criteria: (i) which result better captured the style; (ii) which better preserved the content; and (iii) which was overall a more satisfactory style transfer outcome. We deliberately avoided asking which result was more appealing overall, as general aesthetics are largely orthogonal to style transfer fidelity and can be confounded by preferred colors, content, or external visual elements. We refer to this full collection (style and content images, output images, and pairwise human judgments) as ASTRA-Data.
blocks.zh: 这些结果图像为使用两种替代强制选择设计进行大规模用户研究提供了原材料。 依据三个标准评价的题目是:(一) 更能体现风格;(二) 更能保存内容;(三) 总体上更令人满意的风格转让结果。 我们故意避免问哪个结果在总体上更具吸引力,因为一般的美学基本上正统地向着风格转移忠贞性,并且可以被偏好的颜色、内容或外部视觉元素所混淆。 我们把这个完整的集合(风格和内容图像,输出图像,以及双向人类判断)称为ASTRA-Data.

blocks.en:
Using rank centrality to derive global rankings from these human judgments, we trained ASTRA-Score to predict stylisation effectiveness given a style image, content image, and transfer result. A leave-one-out experimental study indicates that ASTRA-Score achieves substantially greater alignment with human judgement than past automated methods such as
ArtFID [ WO22 ] , SRQE [ CSC∗22 ] , and Gram Loss [ GEB16 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们利用排名中心从这些人类判断中得出全球排名, 我们训练了ASTRA-Score, 预测在风格图像,内容图像, 和传输结果中, 结构化的有效性。 一项 " 一停 " 实验研究表明,ASTRA-Score比以往的自动化方法,如:
ARTFID [WO22],SRQE [CSC*22],以及Gram Loss [GEB16].

blocks.en: This paper contains two main contributions, corresponding to ASTRA’s core components: • ASTRA-Data , the collection of style images, content images, style transfer results, and associated human judgements, establishing a rigorous benchmark for style transfer evaluation. • ASTRA-Score , a network trained on ASTRA-Data to predict style transfer effectiveness on the benchmark image set, allowing reliable automated assessment of performance on the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 本文包含与ASTRA核心组成部分相对应的两个主要贡献: • ASTRA-Data,收集风格图像,内容图像,风格转移结果,以及相关的人类判断,为风格转移评价建立了严格的基准. • ASTRA-Score 是一个受过ASTRA-Data培训的网络,在基准图像集上预测风格转移的有效性,从而可以对基准上的绩效进行可靠的自动化评估。

blocks.en: ASTRA-Data , the collection of style images, content images, style transfer results, and associated human judgements, establishing a rigorous benchmark for style transfer evaluation.
blocks.zh: ASTRA-Data ,收集风格图像,内容图像,风格转移结果,以及相关的人类判断,为风格转移评价建立了严格的基准.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Evaluation in style transfer remains an open problem. The field lacks a unified approach that jointly defines evaluation data, human judgement, and quantitative metrics [ IM24 ] . Existing work typically combines manually selected test images, small-scale user studies, and proxy-based automatic metrics. These components are often designed independently, with limited reproducibility and inconsistent comparisons across methods [ MR17 , ZTZ∗24 ] .
blocks.zh: 风格转移中的评价仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。 本领域缺乏统一的方法,无法共同定义评价数据,人文判断和定量度量[IM24]. 现有工作通常结合人工选取的测试图像,小规模的用户研究和基于代理的自动度量衡. 这些组件往往是独立设计的,可复制性有限,方法比较不一致[MR17,ZTZ*24].

blocks.en: 2.1 Evaluation Dataset for Style Transfer.
blocks.zh: 2.1 样式传输评价数据集。

blocks.en:
Some researchers evaluated results on a small set of manually chosen content–style pairs [ GEB16 ] . Later studies drew from standard datasets, often sampling content images from MS COCO [ LMB∗14 ] and artworks from WikiArt [ MK18 ] , with additional datasets such as KTH [ KTH∗13 ] , BBST4M [ RGC∗24 ] , and Behance [ WFJ∗17 ] used to increase diversity. However, these datasets were primarily designed for general visual understanding rather than stylisation evaluation. In practice, they are used with ad-hoc sampling strategies, leading to unsystematic exploration of content–style combinations, poor coverage of stylistic diversity, and a lack of consistency across studies. These limitations have motivated the development of dedicated evaluation datasets, such as curated NPRgeneral [ MR17 ] and human-annotated datasets like AST-IQAD [ CSC∗22 ] ,
While AST-IQAD [ CSC∗22 ] introduces human-annotated evaluation for stylisation quality and explicitly constructs controlled content–style pairs, its protocol is still based on a fixed set of pre-selected content–style pairs rather than a cross content-style evaluation design that independently probes content and style factors.
Its subjective comparisons remain confined to this fixed pool of generated outputs, making it difficult to disentangle pair-specific difficulty from general method performance. In addition,
the final objective evaluator is constructed from sparse handcrafted feature similarity rather than learned directly from human judgements.
blocks.zh:
一些研究者对一小组手工选择的内容-型配对[GEB16]的结果进行了评价. 后来的研究取材自标准数据集,常从MS COCO[LMB*14]和WikiArt[MK18]的艺术品中取样内容图像,另外还有KTH[KTH*13],BBST4M[RGC*24],Behance[WFJ*17]等用于增加多样性的数据集. 然而,这些数据集主要是为了一般的视觉理解而设计的,而不是对结构化的评价. 在实践中,它们与临时抽样战略一起使用,导致对内容-风格组合的无系统探索,对结构多样性的覆盖度低,以及不同研究之间缺乏一致性。 这些限制促使开发了专门的评价数据集,如编译的NPRgeneral[MR17]和AST-IQAD[CSC*22]等人力说明数据集,
虽然AST-IQAD [CSC*22]引入了人性化附加说明的评价,并明确构建了可控内容-风格的对子,但其协议仍然基于一套固定的预选内容-风格的对子,而不是独立探索内容和风格因素的交叉内容式评价设计.
其主观的比较仍然局限于这种固定的生成产出集合,因此很难从一般方法的性能中分解成对的具体困难. 临Τ
最终目标评价员是根据稀少的手工制作的特征的相似性构建的,而不是直接从人类判断中学到的。

blocks.en: 2.2 Evaluation Methods
blocks.zh: 2.2 评价方法

blocks.en: Early work primarily relied on qualitative side-by-side comparisons of stylised outputs generated from selected content–style pairs [ GEB16 ] . While intuitive, such comparisons are subjective and are unstable with respect to the examples provided. User studies have been widely adopted to assess perceptual quality [ Mou14 ] , typically measuring preferences related to content preservation, style resemblance, and overall quality. Such studies are expensive and difficult to scale. Various automatic metrics have been introduced to provide complementary quantitative signals. Content preservation is often measured using perceptual similarity metrics such as LPIPS [ ZIE∗18 ] or feature similarity derived from pretrained vision models including CLIP [ RKH∗21 ] , Vision Transformers [ DBK∗20 ] , and DINO [ CTM∗21 ] . Distribution-based measures such as FID [ HRU∗17 ] and ArtFID [ WO22 ] have also been adapted for stylisation evaluation. Additional metrics target stylisation quality or perceptual fidelity, including CFSD [ CHH24 ] , SRQE [ CSC∗22 ] ; some recent evaluation [ WYZ∗25 ] uses large vision–language models such as Qwen [ BBC∗23 ] . Another possibility is learned evaluators that decompose stylisation quality into perceptual components such as aesthetic quality, content preservation, and style resemblance [ SGG∗24 , CSMJ24 ] . However, these models are typically trained on proxy signals or limited annotated datasets, and their alignment with human judgement remains limited.
blocks.zh: 早期的工作主要依靠对从选定的内容-型式对产生的定型产出进行质的并排比较[GEB16]。 虽然这种比较是直观的,但主观的,就提供的例子而言是不稳定的。 已广泛采用用户研究来评估知觉质量[Mou14],通常衡量与内容保存、风格相似和整体质量有关的偏好。 这种研究费用昂贵,难以推广。 采用了各种自动计量标准,以提供互补的定量信号。 内容保存常使用LPIPS[ZIE*18]等感知相似度度量衡,或通过预先训练的视觉模型,包括CLIP[RKH*21],Visual Transformers[DBK*20],以及DINO[CTM*21]等特征相似度测量. 诸如FID[HRU*17]和ArtFID[WO22]等基于分销的措施也作了调整,以便进行系统化评估。 附加的衡量标准以造型质量或感知忠诚为目标,包括CFSD[CHH24],SRQE[CSC*22];一些最近的评价[WYZ*25]使用大视觉-语言模型,如Quen[BBC*23]. 另一种可能性是,将结构化质量分解成感知成分,如美学质量、内容保存和风格相似[SGG*24,CSMJ24]。 然而,这些模型通常接受代理信号或有限附加说明的数据集的培训,它们与人类判断的一致性仍然有限.

blocks.en: 3 Construction of ASTRA-Data
blocks.zh: 3 建筑ASTRA数据

blocks.en:
In this section, we describe the construction of ASTRA-Data , including the selection of
style images in Section 3.1 ,
content images in Section 3.2 , and representative stylisation methods in Section 3.3 . We selected
12 style references,
6 content images,
and 12 representative methods, resulting in a total of 864 stylised outputs covering all content–style–method combinations.
This dataset is small enough to permit human evaluations of a substantial fraction of possible pairs, from which global rankings can be computed.

blocks.en: 3.1 Style Image Selection
blocks.zh: 3.1 样式图像选择

blocks.en: A vast array of image styles are possible. In order to balance completeness of coverage with diversity of styles across a small number of images, we opted to use only paintings, and exclude many other worthwhile art media and styles. That said, we took an expansive view in considering the eligibility of a given image, and our final set includes images such as Hokusai’s Great Wave which is a woodcut print.
blocks.zh: 大量的图像样式是可能的。 为了平衡报道的完整性和少数图像的风格多样性,我们选择只使用绘画,排除了许多其他有价值的艺术媒体和风格. 在考虑特定图像的合格性时, 我们用了一个宽广的视角, 最后的一组图片包括诸如Hokusai的大浪,

blocks.en:
We designed our image set around the three dimensions of content, colourfulness, and detail. Content refers to the subject matter being depicted. Colourfulness refers to both the range of colours present in the image and the vividness of individual colours. Detail refers to the presence of intentional fine-scale structure in the depiction of the subject matter, as opposed to more simplified or abstracted depictions that deliberately omit detail.
Organising our image search along these dimensions helped us systematically choose an image set with a broad range and distributed sampling of painterly characteristics.
blocks.zh:
我们围绕着内容、色彩和细节三个方面设计了我们的形象。 内容是指被描绘的主题. 色彩既指图像中存在的色彩范围,也指个人色彩的生动性. 细节是指在对主题物的描绘中存在有意的细度结构,而不是较简化或抽象的刻意省略细节的描述.
沿着这些维度组织我们的图像搜索,帮助我们系统地选择一个具有广泛范围的图像集,并对绘画特征进行分布抽样。

blocks.en:
One might question why we chose to include content as a dimension of style when we have a separate set of content images. A few reasons explain this. Historical painting genres and traditions are often based on content (e.g., portraits, landscapes), and elements and motifs used in style creation can be particular to the content being depicted. On a more technical note, many style transfer methods make use of spatial statistics (e.g., summarised in Gram matrices), and varying the image content helps obtain a broader sampling of styles.
We chose three categories of content: people , encompassing both portraits and
images where humans occupy significant portions of the canvas; nature , including landscapes and other natural scenes;
and artificial , meaning images that are primarily about constructed or manufactured subjects. We extended “artificial” to include abstract images as well.
blocks.zh:
人们可能会问,当我们有一套单独的内容图像时,我们为什么选择将内容作为风格的一个方面。 有几个原因可以解释这一点。 历史绘画流派和传统往往以内容(如肖像画,风景画)为基础,风格创作中使用的元素和调子可以对所描绘的内容特别. 从更技术性的角度看,许多风格转移方法都利用空间统计(例如,在格拉姆矩阵中概述),改变图像内容有助于获得更广泛的样式样本。
我们选择了三种内容:人,包括肖像画和
人类占据大片画布的图像; 自然,包括景观和其他自然场景;
和人造的,意指主要与构造或制造的主体有关的图像. 我们扩大了“人工”范围,将抽象的图像也包括在内。

blocks.en: Secondary considerations subsequently shaped the image set subject to sampling the defined dimensions. We sought representation across a range of historical periods and geographic or cultural contexts. Public - domain availability was a mandatory requirement. We made sure to include works containing distinct motifs or recognisable stylistic markers, as these features provide clearer signals for evaluating style transfer performance. Finally, we endeavoured to incorporate a range of difficulty levels for neural style transfer methods. Some images exhibit relatively straightforward painterly characteristics, such as textured brushwork without deliberate geometric distortion. At the same time, others present significant challenges, including rigid geometric structures, distinctive visual elements, or stylisations that deviate sharply from naturalistic representation. This diversity ensures that the evaluation can capture both the strengths and limitations of existing algorithms and will remain relevant as more capable methods emerge in the future. Discussion of individual style images appears in Appendix A.1 .

blocks.en:
We opted to draw from the already-curated NPRgeneral [ MR17 ] image set. These twenty images cover varied subject matter and visual elements, and collectively offer a wide range of challenges to
NPR methods. Unfortunately, it is impractical to use the full NPRgeneral set: the combinatorial explosion of style, content, and algorithm demands that we keep each category small. We selected six images, taking two images for each of the three content categories already established for style:
people, nature, and artificial.

blocks.en: 3.3 Method Selection

blocks.en:
There is a large literature on neural style transfer (we estimate 500–1000 published methods including all minor variations). To choose a manageable set of methods, we restricted the choice to papers with publicly available code, with a preference for influential papers, along with Multimodal Large Language Models for their generative capabilities different from NST methods.
We began with an initial pool of 20 candidate methods: AAMS [ YRX∗19 ] , AdaAttN [ LLH∗21 ] , AAST [ HJL∗20 ] ,AdaIN [ HB17 ] , AesUST [ WZZ∗22 ] , ArtFlow [ AHS∗21 ] , CCPL [ WZDB22 ] , DiffuseST [ HZG24 ] , Gatys [ GEB16 ] , Gemini [ TAB∗23 ] , ChatGPT [ AAA∗23 ] , IEContraAST [ CWZ∗21 ] , Linear [ LLKY19 ] , OmniStyle [ WLL∗25 ] , RAST [ MZLB23 ] , SANET [ PL19 ] , StyTR-2 [ DTD∗22 ] , StyleID [ CHH24 ] , USO [ WHC∗25 ] , NST-Ghiasi [ GLK∗17 ] ).
To this, we added a suite of handcrafted algorithms based on low-level image processing (LLIP) [ JSO∗01 , TM98 , FXDG17 , TFO23 , RL17 , BVFAB22 , XLXJ11 , LXJ12 , BK69 , KLC07 , PKD07 ] , one per target style;
details appear in Appendix A.2 .

blocks.en:
To finalise the method selection from the candidate pool, we compute pairwise distances between methods using clean-FID [ PZZ22 ] .
For each style, clean-FID is computed between the outputs of two methods under the same content–style conditions, and the final distance is obtained by averaging across all styles.
For each method, we then compute the mean distance to all other methods as a coarse measure of its distinctiveness.
We were then able to exclude methods that did not offer enough variety, as measured by low pairwise distances. This step aims to reduce redundancy while retaining representative approaches. Following this process, we retain a final set of 10 NST methods: AAMS [ YRX∗19 ] , AdaAttN [ LLH∗21 ] , AdaIN [ HB17 ] , ArtFlow [ AHS∗21 ] , Gatys [ GEB16 ] , OmniStyle [ WLL∗25 ] , SANET [ PL19 ] , StyTR-2 [ DTD∗22 ] , USO [ WHC∗25 ] , NST-Ghiasi [ GLK∗17 ] ,
plus ChatGPT [ AAA∗23 ] and the handmade LLIP methods.
This process ensured a high level of diversity among the methods. Examples of selected images in ASTRA-Data produced by different algorithms are shown in Fig. 1 .

然后,我们排除了没有提供足够的多样性的方法,以低双向距离来衡量。 这一步骤旨在减少冗余,同时保留代表性办法。 在此过程之后,我们保留了一套最后的10NST方法:AAMS [YRX∗19],AdaAttN [LLH*21],Adain [HB17],ArtFlow [AHS*21],Gatis [GEB16],OmniStyle [WLL*25],SANET [PL19],StyTR-2 [DTD*22],USO [WHC*25],NST-Ghiasi [GLK*17],

blocks.en: 4 Annotation and Preference Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 注释和优惠分析

blocks.en: We conducted a two-stage online user study on 864 stylised images obtained from our data selection process, with the goal of constructing a human-centred preference dataset. These pairwise judgements were subsequently aggregated using Rank Centrality [ NOS17 ] , enabling us to recover a global ranking over all stylised images as well as corresponding preference scores for content preservation, style similarity, and overall quality. The user study was conducted under approval from the relevant institutional research ethics committee. Participants were recruited through open channels, resulting in 407 submissions. After applying quality control procedures, 264 valid responses were retained for analysis. Participants were compensated upon successful completion of the study.
blocks.zh: 我们对从我们的数据选择过程中获得的864个结构化图像进行了两阶段在线用户研究,目的是构建一个以人为本的偏好数据集。 这些对等的判断后来用 Rank Centrality [NOS17] 进行汇总,使我们能够恢复全球对所有定型图像的排名,以及对内容保存、风格相似性和整体质量的相应优先评分。 用户研究是在有关机构研究道德委员会的批准下进行的。 通过公开渠道招聘了参与者,共提交了407份申请。 在采用质量控制程序后,保留了264份有效答复以供分析。 学员在顺利完成研究后获得补偿。

blocks.en: This section presents the design and execution of the two-stage user study (Section 4.1 ), followed by the procedures used to ensure data quality and annotation reliability (Section 4.2 ). We then examine the adequacy of the collected pairwise comparisons for stable global ranking through simulation (Section 4.3 ). Building on the validated annotations, we describe the construction of preference scores from raw pairwise data (Section 4.4 ) and subsequently analyse the resulting human preference patterns (Section 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 本节介绍两阶段用户研究的设计与执行(第4.1节),然后介绍为确保数据质量和注释可靠性而采用的程序(第4.2节)。 然后,我们审查所收集的对等比较是否足以通过模拟实现稳定的全球排名(第4.3节)。 在经过验证的说明的基础上,我们从原始对等数据(第4.4节)中描述对偏好分数的构建,并随后分析由此产生的人类偏好模式(第4.5节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Two-Stage Study Design and Interface
blocks.zh: 4.1 双阶段研究设计和接口

blocks.en:
In Stage 1 , we perform controlled pairwise comparisons between different methods under the same content–style pair, isolating the effect of the generation method and yielding reliable within-pair preferences. Our design follows the two-alternative forced choice (2AFC) protocol, which provides precise and consistent measurements of aesthetic preferences in style transfer [ So23 ] .
Compared to absolute evaluations such as Likert-scale assessments of image quality, 2AFC admits finer gradations to be expressed, and eliminates problems arising from scale inconsistency among participants. The “forced choice” aspect ensures that participants provide a judgement for every pair, and cannot prematurely abandon the decision by selecting a deliberately excluded “no preference” option.
In Stage 1, we collected 17,568 votes from 122 participants.
blocks.zh:
在第一阶段,我们在同一内容-风格对等下对不同方法进行有控制的对偶比较,隔离生成方法的效果,并产生可靠的pair内偏好。 我们的设计遵循了两种备选的强制选择(2AFC)协议,该协议在风格转移中提供了精确和一致的美学偏好测量[So23].
与Irikrt-scale图像质量评估等绝对评价相比,2AFC承认要表示更细的分级,并消除了参与者之间尺度不一致所产生的问题. “强制选择”方面确保参与者对每一对都作出判断,不能过早地放弃决定,选择一个被故意排除的“不偏好”选项。
在第一阶段,我们从122名参加者那里获得了17 568票。

blocks.en:
Although each method appears in every content–style group, Stage 1 comparisons are local (within the same content-style pairs), preventing a globally consistent ranking for method comparison and metric evaluation.
We collect data for global evaluations in Stage 2 , where participants judge pairwise comparisons across different content–style pairs. These cross-category comparisons enable a coherent global ranking over all stylised images.
The Stage 2 comparisons are perceptually more challenging than those in Stage 1, so each questionnaire in Stage 2 contains fewer tasks. In Stage 2, we collected 17,040 votes from 142 participants, resulting in 34,608 total votes.
The user interface is illustrated in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh:
虽然每种方法都出现在每个内容类组中,但第一阶段的比较是局部的(在同一内容类组内),阻碍了方法比较和衡量评价的全球一致排名。
我们在第二阶段收集全球评价数据, 这些跨类别比较使得能够对所有结构化图像进行协调一致的全球排名。
与第一阶段相比,第二阶段的比较被认为更具挑战性,因此第二阶段的每个问卷都包含较少的任务。 在第二阶段,我们从142名参加者那里获得了17 040张选票,结果共获得34 608张选票。

blocks.en: 4.2 User Study Protocol and Quality Control
blocks.zh: 4.2 用户研究协议和质量控制

blocks.en:
The user study first introduced the task and explained the style transfer concept, with examples and sample tasks.
Participants read an illustrated page explaining the key concepts of content , style , and style transfer using text and visual examples. They then completed a short interactive tutorial with representative examples to familiarise themselves with the evaluation criteria and question format (see details in Appendix B.1 ). On completing the tutorial, the participant begins answering questions about style transfer results from different algorithms. Their answers constitute the user preference data which we record and later analyse.
blocks.zh:
用户研究首先引入了任务,并解释了风格转移概念,并附有实例和样本任务.
与会者阅读了一个插图页,用文字和视觉实例解释内容、样式和样式转移的关键概念。 然后,他们完成了一个简短的互动式辅导,列举了一些有代表性的例子,以便熟悉评价标准和提问格式(详见附录B.1)。 完成教程后,参与者开始回答来自不同算法的风格转移结果的问题. 他们的答案构成我们记录和随后分析的用户偏好数据。

blocks.en:
In both Stage 1 and Stage 2 studies, each comparison required participants to answer three questions:
(1) which stylisation result looks more like an ideal combination of the content and the style?
(2) which result better captures the style? and
(3) which result better preserves the content?

This setup yields reliable within-group preferences under controlled conditions. Stage 2 consisted of cross-group comparisons, connecting different content-style pairs.

blocks.en: 4.3 Two-Stage Ranking Stability Simulation
blocks.zh: 4.3 双阶排列稳定性模拟

blocks.en:
We analyse whether the number of pairwise comparisons in our two-stage study was sufficient to support stable ranking estimation.
Spectral ranking theory [ NOS17 , CS15 ] suggests that reliable recovery scales as Θ ⁡ ( n ​ log ⁡ n ) \Theta(n\log n) under models such as Bradley-Terry-Luce [ BT52 , L∗59 ] , providing a theoretical reference for the required comparison scale.
We further validate this empirically via simulation using Rank Centrality [ NOS17 ] .
For Stage 1, ranking stability rapidly converges and exceeds ρ = 0.99 \rho=0.99 , where ρ \rho denotes the Spearman rank correlation between the estimated ranking and the reference ranking, at approximately 1.2 × 10 4 1.2\times 10^{4} comparisons.
For Stage 2, global ranking accuracy improves steadily with additional cross-group comparisons, reaching ρ ≈ 0.95 \rho\approx 0.95 at around 1.4 × 10 4 1.4\times 10^{4} comparisons.
In practice, our study collected 17,568 (Stage 1) and 17,040 (Stage 2) votes, both of which lie well within the stable regime. See more details in Appendix C .

blocks.en:
Empirical graph diagnostics. We additionally examine the topology of the comparison graph constructed from the actual collected annotations. As expected, Stage 1 alone forms 72 disconnected components corresponding to the 12 style references and 6 content references. The cross-group comparisons introduced in Stage 2 connect these components, yielding a single connected comparison graph over all 864 stylised results. The combined graph has an average node
degree of approximately 45.4. The Rank Centrality transition matrices for content, style, and overall preference have spectral gaps of 0.0199, 0.0421, and 0.1000, respectively. We further perform 100 stratified bootstrap resamplings of the collected comparisons; all resampled graphs remain connected and Rank Centrality can be successfully computed in
every case. Together with the ranking-recovery simulation above, these diagnostics confirm that the global rankings are not obtained from disconnected comparison components and remain stable under resampling. Further connectivity and bootstrap analyses are provided in Appendix C.1 .

blocks.en: 4.4 Preference Score Estimation
blocks.zh: 4.4 优先评分估计

blocks.en:
To obtain reliable preference scores, we combine pairwise comparisons from both stages of the user study.
Stage 1 provides comparisons across methods under identical ( content , style ) (\text{content},\text{style}) conditions, while Stage 2 connects different content–style pairs to enable meaningful global rankings.
blocks.zh:
为了获得可靠的偏好分数,我们将用户研究的两个阶段的对等比较结合起来.

Our goal is to recover a global preference ranking for each criterion. Each generated image is treated as a player: p = ( style , content , method ) . p=(\text{style},\text{content},\text{method}). Ranking from Pairwise Comparisons. Given these pairwise comparisons between players, we adopt Rank Centrality [ NOS17 ] to estimate global rankings.
Rank Centrality is a spectral method that interprets comparison outcomes as transitions of a Markov chain and recovers rankings from its stationary distribution.

从Pairwise比较排名. 鉴于这些玩家之间的双向比较,我们采用Rank Centrality[NOS17]来估计全球排名.

blocks.en:
To further understand this phenomenon, we analyse cases where content and style preferences disagree. Across a total of 18,747 18{,}747 such conflict cases, participants follow the style preference in 80.3 % 80.3\% of comparisons, compared to 19.7 % 19.7\% for content. This trend aligns with the observations from Fig. 4 , where the overall preference ranking closely aligns with style preference across methods.
The evidence supports the hypothesis that for the style transfer task, humans are more sensitive to discrepancies in the style than in the content.

证据支持这样的假设,即对于风格转移任务,人类对风格差异的敏感度高于内容.

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 shows the top-5 and bottom-5 results ranked by overall preference scores.
Top-ranked results often correspond to styles with strong and distinctive visual cues (e.g., Chinese landscape, Carr), suggesting that clear colour and texture patterns are more readily perceived and evaluated.
In contrast, bottom-ranked results exhibit two common failure modes: severe content degradation, where structure becomes unrecognisable (e.g., Rembrandt), and weak stylisation, where content is preserved but stylistic cues are minimal (e.g., Australian Aboriginal, Hokusai).
These observations indicate that both recognisable content and perceptually salient style cues are important, with the latter playing a particularly prominent role.

blocks.en: Next, we introduce ASTRA-Score , an evaluation model trained on ASTRA-Data , and compare it with existing metrics on the benchmark image set.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们介绍ASTRA-Score,这是一个在ASTRA-Data上经过培训的评价模型,并与基准图像集上的现有衡量标准进行比较。

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation Model

blocks.en:
To enable automatic assessment of stylised images, we learn a regression-based evaluation model that predicts human-aligned scores from a content-style-stylisation image triplet, as illustrated in Fig. 8 .
Given a content reference image I c I_{c} , a style reference image I s I_{s} , and a generated stylised image I g I_{g} , the goal is to estimate how well the generated result preserves the content structure and matches the target style, and forms an ideal combination of the two.
We train three separate predictors corresponding to three evaluation criteria: overall preference , content preservation , and style similarity .
Using the fully trained model, we can evaluate new stylisation methods on the benchmark image set.
We employ a frozen pretrained backbone to extract hierarchical visual
representations and train only lightweight task-specific regression heads.
We empirically compare several backbone families, including MobileNetV3,
VGG, ResNet, ViT, and DINOv2. Among the evaluated architectures, VGG11
provides the strongest overall alignment with human judgements across the
three evaluation criteria, and is therefore adopted as the default backbone
for ASTRA-Score. The backbone remains frozen throughout training, limiting
the number of trainable parameters to the regression heads. Full results of the backbone comparison are provided in Appendix F .

We evaluate whether objective metrics can predict perceptual rankings on ASTRA-Data, which contains 12 12 styles, 6 6 contents, and 12 12 stylisation methods.
To assess generalisation across methods, we adopt a leave-one-method-out protocol.
In each run, one method is held out while the remaining 11 11 methods are used to train the prediction model, which then predicts the ranking of the held-out method over its 72 72 generated images.
The predicted ranking is compared with the global rankings using Spearman’s ρ \rho [ Spe61 ] and Kendall’s τ \tau [ Ken38 ] .
This process is repeated for all 12 12 methods, and the final performance is reported as the average correlation across runs.

blocks.en:
We further evaluate a range of commonly used style transfer metrics, including style similarity, content preservation, and overall quality measures, under the same protocol.
For each metric, rankings are computed for the held-out method and compared with the ground truth in the same manner.
Tab. 2 reveals a clear gap between existing automatic metrics and perceptual preference. SRQE [ CSC∗22 ] achieves relatively strong performance, demonstrating the value of human-annotated supervision among prior approaches. However, its reliance on fixed content–style pairs entangles scores with pair-specific difficulty, and its evaluator is still based on handcrafted features rather than directly learned from user evaluations.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评估一系列常用的样式传输计量标准,包括样式相似性、内容保存以及同一协议下的总体质量计量。
每种衡量标准,对搁置方法进行排名,并以同样方式与地面真相进行比较。
标签2揭示了现有自动衡量标准与观念偏好之间的明显差距。 SRQE[CSC*22]取得了相对较强的绩效,显示了人类附加说明的监督在以往做法中的价值. 然而,它依赖固定内容-风格的对子缠绕着有对子特异性难度的分数,其评价者仍然基于手工的特征,而不是直接从用户评价中学习.

blocks.en: Even the best prior automatic metrics achieve only moderate correlation with human rankings, while several widely used measures (e.g., CFSD [ CHH24 ] and SIFID (Single Image FID) [ SDM19 ] ) exhibit weak correlation in the content evaluation, indicating that minimising perceptual distance does not necessarily lead to more preferred stylisations.
blocks.zh: 甚至最好的前置自动度量衡也仅与人类排名实现中度关联,而一些被广泛使用的度量衡(如CFSD[CHH24]和SIFID(单一图像FID)[SDM19])在内容评价中表现出微弱的关联性,表明最小的感知距离并不一定导致更偏好的阶梯化.

blocks.en:
The discrepancy is even more pronounced for style and overall evaluations: classical statistics such as Gram Loss [ GEB16 ] and recent pretrained vision-language model based metrics, including embedding-based similarity (e.g., CLIP [ RKH∗21 ] )
and instruction following models such as Qwen [ BBC∗23 ] , show low and inconsistent correlation with human judgements, suggesting that stylistic quality perceived by humans is not captured by simple feature statistics.
Across all evaluation heads, our metric consistently achieves substantially higher correlation with study-derived rankings, demonstrating a stronger alignment with the perceptual criteria governing neural style transfer quality.
blocks.zh:
这种差异在风格和总体评价方面更为明显:古典统计,如Gram Loss[GEB16]和最近经过预先培训的基于视觉语言模型的衡量标准,包括基于嵌入的类似性(例如CLIP[RKH*21])
以及遵循Quen[BBC*23]等模型的指令,显示出与人类判断的低和不一致的关联性,说明人类所感知到的风格品质并没有被简单的特征统计所捕捉.
在所有评价负责人中,我们的衡量标准与研究产生的排名之间一直保持高得多的相关性,表明与关于神经风格转移质量的认知标准更加一致。

blocks.en: Generalisation to unseen content and styles. The leave-one-method-out (LOMO) protocol above directly reflects the intended use of ASTRA-Score: evaluating a new style transfer method applied to the fixed content and style references in ASTRA-Data. In each split, the evaluated stylisation method is unseen during training, while the benchmark references remain available. We additionally conduct leave-one-content-out (LOCO) and leave-one-style-out (LOSO) experiments as robustness analyses rather than as tests of the intended deployment setting. These experiments examine whether the strong performance of ASTRA-Score depends on having observed every benchmark reference during training. By withholding an entire content or style reference together with all associated stylised results, LOCO and LOSO provide a stricter test of reference dependence and indicate whether the learnt evaluator captures transferable relationships between reference and stylised images rather than simply memorising the specific content and style images in the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 概括到看不见的内容和风格。 上面的留置一法(LOMO)协议直接反映了ASTRA-Score的预期用途:评价ASTRA-Data中适用于固定内容和样式引用的新样式传输方法. 在每次拆分中,在培训期间都看不到经过评估的分层法,而基准参考文献仍然可用。 我们还进行 " 一内容 " (LOCO)和 " 一类型 " (LOSO)的试验,作为稳健性分析,而不是作为预定部署环境的试验。 这些实验研究了ASTRA-Score的强效表现是否取决于在培训期间观察了每一个基准参考。 LOCO和LOSO通过不将全部内容或样式参考与所有相关的系统化结果一起使用,更严格地检验了参考依赖性,并表明所学评价人员是否掌握了参考和系统化图像之间的可转让关系,而不是仅仅回忆基准中的具体内容和样式图像。

blocks.en: For LOCO, all stylised images associated with one content reference are held out for testing, while ASTRA-Score is trained on the remaining five contents; this is repeated for all six contents. Table 3 reports the results. ASTRA-Score achieves Spearman correlations of 0.745, 0.814, and 0.793 for content, style, and overall preference, respectively, outperforming the strongest baselines by 53.9% for style and 45.5% for overall preference. DINO achieves a slightly higher correlation (0.759 vs. 0.745), consistent with the strong semantic and structural representations learnt through large-scale self-supervised pretraining. Overall, ASTRA-Score remains strongly aligned with human judgements despite excluding an entire content reference and its associated samples from training.
blocks.zh: 对LOCO来说,所有与一个内容参考相关的定型图像都保留下来进行测试,而ASTRA-Score则接受关于其余五个内容的培训;所有六个内容都重复使用。 表3汇报了结果。 ASTRA-Score在内容,风格和整体偏好方面分别实现了0.745,0.814和0.793的Spearman相关,在风格方面表现优于最强基线53.9%,在整体偏好方面则超过45.5%. DINO实现了略高的关联性(0.759 vs. 0.745),与通过大规模自我监督的预训吸取的强烈语义和结构表现一致. 总体而言,ASTRA-Score虽然将整个内容参考及其相关样本排除在培训之外,但依然与人类判断保持一致。

blocks.en: For LOSO, all stylised images associated with one style reference are similarly held out, with results averaged over the twelve styles (Table 4 ). ASTRA-Score achieves Spearman correlations of 0.711, 0.700, and 0.658 for content, style, and overall preference, respectively, outperforming the strongest baselines of 0.673, 0.522, and 0.525. Together, the LOCO and LOSO results indicate that ASTRA-Score learns transferable evaluation cues rather than simply memorising the content and style references observed during training.
blocks.zh: 对LOSO来说,所有与一种风格参考相关的定型图像同样被保留,结果平均为十二种风格(表4)。 ASTRA-Score分别实现了Spearman的0.711,0.700和0.658对内容,风格,和总体偏好等关联,表现优于0.673,0.522和0.525的最强基线. LOCO和LOSO的结果表明,ASTRA-Score学习了可转移的评价提示,而不是简单地回忆培训期间观察到的内容和风格参考。

blocks.en: Robustness across evaluation protocols. Taken together, the three protocols examine complementary aspects of ASTRA-Score. LOMO constitutes the primary evaluation and directly reflects its intended use: assessing unseen stylisation methods on the ASTRA benchmark. LOCO and LOSO provide stricter tests by additionally withholding entire content or style references from training. The strong correlations under these settings indicate that ASTRA-Score does not simply memorise reference-specific patterns, but learns relationships between content, style, and stylised outputs that generalise to unseen references. Although such reference-level generalisation extends beyond the primary intended use of ASTRA-Score, the results demonstrate its robustness when applied to content or style references not observed during training.
blocks.zh: 强力跨越评价协议. 三项议定书合在一起审查了ASTRA-Score的补充方面。 LOMO是主要评价,直接反映其预期用途:在ASTRA基准上评估无形的分层化方法。 LOCO和LOSO提供更严格的测试,另外从培训中不提供全部内容或风格参考。 这些设置下的强烈相关性表明,ASTRA-Score不仅仅记忆了参考特定模式,而是学习了内容,风格,和一般化为无形参考内容的定型输出之间的关系. 虽然这种参考层面的概括性超出了ASTRA-Score的主要预期用途,但结果表明,当应用到培训期间没有观察到的内容或风格参考时,这种通用性是强有力的。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we systematically investigate the reliability of automatic evaluation metrics for neural style transfer using a human preference benchmark.
Our results reveal clear limitations of existing metrics, which often fail to align with perceptual judgement, while conventional user studies remain time-consuming, difficult to reproduce, and lack comparability across works.
In this paper, we propose ASTRA, an evaluation mechanism for style transfer. We construct ASTRA-Data , a representative yet tractable benchmark dataset of content–style pairs with pairwise preference annotations, from which we derive ranking-based ground truth for content preservation, style similarity, and overall preference.
We used the user study data to train ASTRA-Score , an evaluation model that predicts preference-aligned scores from content-style-stylisation image triplet, enabling scalable and consistent evaluation across methods: ASTRA-Score provides reliable estimates of stylisation effectiveness on our benchmark image set. Together, ASTRA-Data and ASTRA-Score provide a standardised testbed for benchmarking style transfer methods via their alignment with human rankings.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们系统调查了使用人类偏好基准进行神经风格转移的自动评价指标的可靠性.
我们的结果表明,现有衡量标准存在明显的局限性,往往无法与概念判断保持一致,而传统的用户研究仍然很费时,难以复制,各作品之间缺乏可比性。
在本文中,我们提出ASTRA,一种风格转移的评价机制. 我们构建了 ASTRA-Data(ASTRA-Data ) , 一个具有代表性但可操作性的基准数据集,其中包含有双向偏好说明的内容组合,我们从中得出基于排名的地面真理来保存内容,风格相似,以及总体偏好.
我们利用用户研究数据来训练ASTRA-Score(ASTRA-Score),这个评价模型从内容风格的stylization图像三进制中预测偏好对应的分数,能够实现跨方法的可伸缩和一致的评价:ASTRA-Score为我们的基准图像集提供了对stylization有效性的可靠估计. ASTRA-Data和ASTRA-Score共同提供了一个标准化的测试台,通过它们与人类排名的一致来测试基准样式转移方法。

blocks.zh: 附录A 基准数据选择和生成细节

blocks.en: This section provides a detailed account of the construction of ASTRA. It outlines the principles guiding the selection of style images, ensuring diversity in artistic characteristics such as colour, texture, structural complexity, and cultural origin. In addition, it describes the implementation details of the LLIP (low-level image processing) methods, which are designed to complement learning-based approaches by approximating styles that are difficult to capture with existing neural models.
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍了ASTRA的建设情况. 它概述了选择风格形象的指导原则,确保了色彩、纹理、结构复杂性和文化渊源等艺术特征的多样性。 此外,它还描述了LLIP(低级图像处理)方法的实施细节,这些方法旨在通过近似的风格来补充以学习为基础的方法,这些风格难以与现有的神经模型一起捕捉.

blocks.en: A.1 Style Images Selection
blocks.zh: A.1 样式图像选择

blocks.en: Hokusai (nature, low colour, low detail; Asia, 19th century) This iconic woodblock print contains highly recognizable motifs, most notably the sweeping arcs of the crashing wave. It has minimal shading and limited texture, instead relying on strong contour lines and flat regions of solid colour. It has seen use in prior NST evaluation, providing some continuity (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Great_Wave_off_Kanagawa.jpg ).
blocks.zh: 霍库赛(自然,低颜色,低细节;亚洲,19世纪). 这种标志性的木块印刷物中包含着非常可辨识的齿轮,最显著的是坠落波的横弧. 它的阴影最小,纹理有限,相反依赖于坚固的轮廓线和平整的固体颜色区域. 它在之前的NST评价中有使用,提供了一些连续性(原始图像可见于https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Great_Wave_off_Kanagawa.jpg).

blocks.en: Rembrandt (people, low colour, high detail; Europe, 17th century) The chosen image is characterized by strong global contrast and a muted palette. The illuminated areas contain detailed, naturalistic rendering of facial features and fabric, while the background regions are darker and simpler. The combination of high detail, low colour saturation, and straightforward overall composition means that it should be easy to evaluate the effectiveness of stylization while potentially challenging to achieve it (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rembrandt,_Self_Portrait_at_the_Age_of_34.jpg ).
blocks.zh: 伦勃朗(人,低色,高细节;17世纪欧洲) 所选择的图像的特点是强烈的全球对比和变调色板. 照明区包含面部特征和布料的详细自然渲染,而背景区域则更暗,更简单. 高细节、低颜色饱和度和直截了当的整体构成相结合,意味着应易于评价结构化的有效性,同时可能具有实现这种结构的挑战性(原始图像见https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rembrandt,_Self_Portrait_at_the_Age_of_34.jpg)。

blocks.en: Chinese Landscape (nature, low colour, high detail; Asia, 19th century) This image, in the style of a traditional landscape painting, uses fine brushwork and texture to convey foliage, landscape, and atmospheric depth. The style includes large areas of empty or lightly worked space, which can be difficult for NST methods that assume dense texture. The image is monochromatic, relying strictly on tone and line weight to convey content (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E6%98%8E_%E6%B2%88%E5%91%A8_%EF%BC%8C_%E6%96%87%E5%BE%B5%E6%98%8E-%E5%90%88%E7%92%A7%E5%B1%B1%E6%B0%B4%E5%9C%96_%E5%8D%B7-Joint_Landscape_MET_DP235652.jpg ).
blocks.zh: 中国风景名胜区(自然,低颜色,高细节;亚洲,19世纪) 这种形象以传统风景画的风格,使用精细的刷子和纹理来传达叶片,景观,和大气深度. 风格包括大片空或轻工的空间,对于假设密集纹理的NST方法来说可能很困难. 该图像是单色的,严格依赖基调和线条重量来传递内容(原始图像可在https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File 上获得:%E6%98%8E%%E6%B2%88%E5%91%A8%EF%BC%8C%E6%96%E5%BE%B5%98%E7%92%A7%E5%B1%B1%B1%E6%B4%E5%C%96%E5%B7-UTU_Landscape_MET_DP25652.jpg)).

blocks.en:
Bierstadt (nature, high colour, high detail; North America, 19th century) The selected landscape is brightly coloured and highly detailed, with dramatic lighting and a strong sense of depth. Although the painting aims for a plausible naturalistic appearance, it remains clearly painterly, but subtly so: methods that depend on crude cues such as severe texture will struggle.
The image provides a foil to the Veronese, which is colourful but less dramatic and offers its own challenges (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bierstadt_Albert_On_the_Saco.jpg ).
blocks.zh:
比耶尔施塔特(自然,高色,高细节;北美,19世纪) 所选的景观色彩明亮,非常详细,具有戏剧性的照明和强烈的深度感. 虽然这幅画旨在呈现出一种可信的自然主义的外观,但它仍然明显地是画家,但巧妙地如此:那些依赖于粗糙的提示的方法,如严重的纹理,会挣扎.
该图像为维罗内塞人提供了泡影,而维罗内塞人虽多彩但不太戏剧化,也提出了自己的挑战(原始图像见于https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bierstadt_Albert_On_the_Saco.jpg).

blocks.en: Picasso (people, low colour, low detail; Europe, 20th century) Guernica is among the most important and influential works of the 20th century. It contains deliberate distortion of human figures, simplified shapes, and a monochromatic palette. Portions of the image resemble line drawing. This image challenges the proposition that style and content can be cleanly separated (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mural_del_%22Guernica%22_de_Picasso.jpg ).
blocks.zh: 毕加索(人,低颜色,低细节;欧洲,20世纪) 格尔尼察是20世纪最重要的和有影响力的作品之一. 它包含了刻意歪曲人类人物,简化形状,以及单色调色板. 图像的像线画。 这个图像挑战了风格和内容可以干净分离的主张(原始图像可在https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mural_del_%22Guernica%22_de_Picasso.jpg上获得).

blocks.en: Carr (nature, high colour, low detail; North America, 19th century) The selected painting uses bold, simplified forms and an unconventional colour scheme. Geometric distortion and broad, smooth regions dominate the composition. We anticipate that texture will be uninformative for this style, while colour and (when available for a given method) distortion of shape will dominate (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Emily_Carr_-_Trees_in_France.jpg ).
blocks.zh: 卡尔(自然,高肤色,低细节;北美,19世纪) . 所选绘画采用粗体,简化的形式和一种非常规的彩色方案. 几何扭曲和广泛、平滑的区域在组成中占主导地位。 我们预计,这种风格的纹理将无法形成,而颜色和(在特定方法可用时)形状扭曲将占主导地位(原始图像见https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Emily_Carr___Trees_in_France.jpg)。

blocks.en: Veronese (people, high colour, high detail; Europe, 16th century) This Renaissance painting contains clearly defined objects, controlled lighting, and a colourful, harmonious palette. Brush texture is minimal; the rendering style is precise. Like the Bierstadt, this image aims at a realistic aesthetic, yet is clearly painterly (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Paolo_Veronese_-_The_Marriage_at_Cana_(detail)_-_WGA24859.jpg ).
blocks.zh: 维罗内塞(人,高色,高细节;16世纪欧洲) 这幅文艺复兴时期的油画中包含着明确界定的物体,受控的照明,以及一种色彩丰富,和谐的调色板. 刷子纹理最小;渲染风格精确. 与比耶尔施塔特人一样,这个图像旨在现实的美学,但明显是画派的(原始图像见于https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Paolo_Veronese_-_The_marriage_at_Cana_(detail)_-_WGA24859.jpg).

blocks.en: Australian Aboriginal (artificial, high colour, low detail; Australia, 20th century) The selected work, a modern exemplar of a traditional style, incorporates motifs such as dots, circles, and sinusoidal lines. These discrete elements do not form continuous textures, making them difficult for texture - based NST approaches. Success on this style would indicate an ability to reproduce styles with distinct individual elements, such as mosaics (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aboriginal-art-503444_960_720.jpg ).
blocks.zh: 澳大利亚土著(人工、高肤色、低细节;澳大利亚,20世纪) 所选的作品是传统风格的现代实例,包含点,圆,鼻线等摩托体. 这些离散的元素不形成连续的纹理,使其难以形成以纹理为基础的NST方法. 这种风格的成功将表明能够以独特的个别要素复制风格,如镶嵌图案(原始图像见于https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Abbrient-art-503444_960_720.jpg)。

blocks.en: Mondrian (artificial, high colour, low detail; Europe, 20th century) This image consists of rectangular regions of primary colours separated by black lines. Its deceptive simplicity depends on exact geometry and precise colour placement. We expect many NST methods to struggle with this style; indeed, while reproducing the style algorithmically is feasible, it is not clear how the rectangular blocks can convey concrete subject matter. We include this image as a stress test and as motivation for future work (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Piet_Mondriaan,_1921_-_Composition_en_rouge,_jaune,_bleu_et_noir.jpg ).
blocks.zh: 蒙德里安(人工,高色,低细;欧洲,20世纪) 这个图像由黑线分隔的主要颜色的长方形区域组成. 其欺骗性的简单性取决于准确的几何和准确的色彩布局. 我们期望许多NST方法与这种风格相抗衡;实际上,虽然从算法上复制风格是可行的,但不清楚长方形块如何传递具体的主题. 我们将此图像作为压力测试和今后工作的动力(原始图像见https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Piet_Mondriaan,_1921_-_Composition_en_rouge,_jaune,_bleu_et_noir.jpg).

blocks.en: Kandinsky (artificial, high colour, high detail; Europe, 20th century) The selected painting contains numerous geometric and distinct visual motifs. Although abstract, the elements are flexible enough to be repurposed into representational contexts. The complexity and specificity of these elements make the style difficult to capture (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vassily_Kandinsky,_1939_-_Composition_10.jpg ).
blocks.zh: 坎丁斯基(人工,高色彩,高细节;欧洲,20世纪). 所选绘画中包含着众多几何和独特的视觉摩托. 这些要素虽然抽象,但具有足够的灵活性,可以重新用于代表性背景。 这些元素的复杂性和特殊性使得风格难以捕捉(原始图像可见于https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vassily_Kandinsky,_1939_-_Composition_10.jpg).

blocks.en: Ptolemaic Egyptian (people, colourful, low detail; Africa, 350–300 BCE) This image features flat regions of colour, clear separation between foreground and background, and stylised depictions of human figures. The perspective and proportions follow historical conventions rather than naturalistic ones. These properties test whether methods can reproduce stylised structure without imposing naturalistic shading or texture (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:P1200377_Louvre_Stele_Ousirour_detail_D_N2699_rwk.jpg ).
blocks.zh: Ptolemaic 埃及语(人,色彩鲜艳,细节低;非洲,350-300BCE) 这种形象以平坦的颜色区域为特色,在前缘和背景之间明显分离,对人物的刻板描写. 观点和比例遵循的是历史惯例,而不是自然惯例。 这些属性检验方法是否能够在不强加自然主义的阴影或纹理的情况下复制成型的结构(原始图像见于https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:P1200377_Louvre_Stele_Ousirour_detail_D_N2699_rwk.jpg).

blocks.en: Gris (artificial, low colour, low detail; Europe, 20th century) The fragmented shapes, overlapping planes, and occasional symbolic elements in this work make it supremely challenging. The central violin is depicted partly by shape and partly by line drawing. Although the palette is limited, the spatial organization is complex. Balancing content preservation with stylistic transformation will be a severe challenge (original image available at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Juan_Gris_-_Komposition_mit_Violine.jpeg ).
blocks.zh: 格里斯(人工,低颜色,低细节;欧洲,20世纪) 这项工作中零散的形状、重叠的飞机和偶尔出现的象征性因素,使其具有极大的挑战性。 中央小提琴部分用形状描绘,部分用线条绘画. 虽然调色板有限,但空间组织复杂. 平衡内容保存与结构转型将是一个严峻的挑战(原始图像见https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Juan_Gris_-_Komposition_mit_Violine.jpeg).

blocks.en: A.2 Details of LLIP Method Construction
blocks.zh: A.2 LLIP方法构建的细节

blocks.en:
The LLIP (low-level image processing) category represents a set of hand-crafted approaches designed to approximate diverse artistic styles.
Given the absence of a single model capable of covering all styles, we construct this set using a combination of existing methods, hybrid pipelines, and custom-designed procedures.
blocks.zh:
LLIP(低水平图像处理)类别代表了一套手工制作的方法,旨在近似于多种艺术风格.
由于没有能够覆盖所有风格的单一模型,我们采用现有方法、混合管道和定制程序等组合来构建这一集。

blocks.en: A.2.1 Design Strategies
blocks.zh: A.2.1 设计战略

blocks.en: We adopt four main strategies to construct LLIP stylisations:
blocks.zh: 我们采取四项主要战略来构建利普系统结构:

blocks.en: • Style-aligned method selection. Existing methods are selected when their visual characteristics align well with the target style (e.g., Kandinsky, Bierstadt). • Method combination. Multiple methods are combined, either sequentially or by averaging their outputs, to better approximate complex styles (e.g., Rembrandt, Chinese landscape, Veronese). • Multi-style methods. Some approaches are capable of representing multiple styles and are directly applied (e.g., image analogies for Aboriginal art and The Great Wave). • Custom pipelines. For styles not well supported by existing methods, custom pipelines are designed (e.g., Mondrian, Carr, Picasso, Ptolemaic Egyptian).
blocks.zh: • 样式匹配方法选择。 当其视觉特征与目标样式(如坎丁斯基,比耶尔施塔特)吻合时,会选择现有方法. • 方法组合。 多种方法或相继结合,或通过平均输出,以更好地近似复杂的风格(如伦勃朗,中国景观,维罗内塞). • 多式方法。 有些方法能够代表多种风格,并直接应用(例如土著艺术和大浪的图像类比). • 定制管道。 对于得不到现有方法良好支持的样式,定制管道的设计(如蒙德里安,卡尔,毕加索,普托勒米克埃及语).

blocks.en: Style-aligned method selection. Existing methods are selected when their visual characteristics align well with the target style (e.g., Kandinsky, Bierstadt).
blocks.zh: 样式对齐的方法选择 。 当其视觉特征与目标样式(如坎丁斯基,比耶尔施塔特)吻合时,会选择现有方法.

blocks.en: Method combination. Multiple methods are combined, either sequentially or by averaging their outputs, to better approximate complex styles (e.g., Rembrandt, Chinese landscape, Veronese).
blocks.zh: 方法组合. 多种方法或相继结合,或通过平均输出,以更好地近似复杂的风格(如伦勃朗,中国景观,维罗内塞).

blocks.en: Multi-style methods. Some approaches are capable of representing multiple styles and are directly applied (e.g., image analogies for Aboriginal art and The Great Wave).
blocks.zh: 多风格的方法. 有些方法能够代表多种风格,并直接应用(例如土著艺术和大浪的图像类比).

blocks.en: Custom pipelines. For styles not well supported by existing methods, custom pipelines are designed (e.g., Mondrian, Carr, Picasso, Ptolemaic Egyptian).
blocks.zh: 定制管道. 对于得不到现有方法良好支持的样式,定制管道的设计(如蒙德里安,卡尔,毕加索,普托勒米克埃及语).

blocks.en: A.2.2 Style-Specific Implementations
blocks.zh: A.2.2 特定样式的执行

blocks.en:
We employ image analogies [ JSO∗01 ] as the base method.
For Great Wave, this is further combined with colour transfer using distribution matching [ PKD07 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们使用图像模拟[JSO*01]作为基础方法.
为伟大的 波浪,这与使用配对发行[PKD07]的颜色传输进一步结合.

blocks.en:
We combine bilateral filtering [ TM98 ] with a custom colour mapping procedure based on look-up tables (LUT).
We applied histogram matching between grayscale versions of the content and style images.
For each intensity level, the average RGB colour is computed from the style image to construct a mapping, which is then applied to the content image.
blocks.zh:
我们把双边过滤[TM98]与基于查询表(LUT)的自定义色彩映射程序结合起来.
我们用直方图来匹配 灰度版本的内容和样式图像
对于每个强度级别,平均RGB颜色从样式图像计算到构建映射,然后应用于内容图像.

blocks.en: We use a structured abstraction framework [ FXDG17 ] to produce simplified geometric representations consistent with the style.
blocks.zh: 我们使用结构化抽象框架[FXDG17]来制作与风格一致的简化几何表示.

blocks.en:
We apply the brushify filter from G’MIC [ TFO23 ] .
For images containing foreground objects, the foreground is processed using brushify, while the background is rendered using a watercolour model [ RL17 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们使用来自G ' MIC [TFO23]的刷新过滤器。
对于包含前景对象的图像,前景用刷子处理,而背景则使用水色模型[RL17]渲染.

blocks.en:
We compute the average of multiple stylisations, including:
(1) brushify filtering [ TFO23 ] ,
(2) L 0 L_{0} smoothing [ XLXJ11 ] ,
(3) outputs from the Waterlogue application, and
(4) adaptive morphological filtering [ BVFAB22 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们计算多个阶梯的平均值,包括:
(1) 刷过滤[TFO23],
(2) L 0 L_{0} 平滑 [XLXJ11],
(3) 水龙星应用的输出,以及
(4)适应性形态过滤[BVFAB22].

blocks.en: We combine brush-based rendering [ TFO23 ] with sketch extraction [ LXJ12 ] , and average the resulting outputs.
blocks.zh: 我们把基于刷子的渲染[TFO23]和草图提取[LXJ12]结合起来,并平均得出结果.

blocks.en:
A custom pipeline is designed as follows: the image is first blurred and segmented into a fixed number of colour layers based on basic colour categories [ BK69 ] .
Textures are added to each layer, and line drawings extracted using coherent line detection [ KLC07 ] are overlaid.
The process is applied to both the original and intensity-equalised images, and the results are combined.
Background regions are recoloured separately using a reduced palette.
blocks.zh:
定制的管道设计如下: 图像首先模糊,并根据基本颜色类别[BK69]划分成固定的颜色层.
每层都添加纹理,并用连贯的线条检测法提取的线条图案[KLC07]被覆盖.
过程既适用于原始图像,也适用于强度均匀的图像,结果被综合.
背景区域使用减色调色板单独重排.

blocks.en:
A stylised abstraction is constructed by converting the image to grayscale, quantising intensities, and applying median filtering.
Line drawings [ KLC07 ] are overlaid, followed by the addition of structured noise and grid-like patterns.
blocks.zh:
通过将图像转换成灰度,量化强度,以及应用中位过滤来构建一个层次化的抽象.
线图[KLC07]为叠加图案,后加结构噪声和网格状图案.

blocks.en:
The image is downscaled and each pixel is mapped to a restricted colour palette.
Rectangular regions are iteratively extracted and expanded to form block structures, with boundary lines extended to create a grid-like composition.
blocks.zh:
图像被降级,每个像素被映射到一个限制的色调色板.
矩形区域被迭代提取并扩展为块状结构,边界线被扩展,形成类似网格的构成.

blocks.en: We segment the content image with SLIC0, generating medium-large regions that approximately conform to object boundaries. Next, we assign a random painterly texture to each, recolouring the texture to match the average content colour within each region. Note that this emphasizes shape abstraction and not colour; in particular, it does not use the unusual colour distribution characteristic of Carr’s style.
blocks.zh: 我们用 SLIC0 分隔内容图像,生成大致符合对象边界的中等区域。 接下来,我们给每个区域分配一个随机的绘画纹理,重排纹理,以匹配每个区域的平均内容颜色. 请注意,这强调形状抽象而不是颜色;特别是,它没有使用卡尔风格的不寻常的颜色分布特征.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Top-3 and bottom-3 stylised results for each method ranked by overall human preference scores. In each row, the left three images show the top-3 results and the right three show the bottom-3 results. Methods are listed in alphabetical order: AAMS, AdaAttN, AdaIN, ArtFlow, ChatGPT, NST-Ghiasi, Gatys, LLIP, OmniStyle, SANET, StyTR-2, and USO.
blocks.zh: 图9:按人类整体偏好分数排名的每种方法的上-3和下-3的定型结果. 每行中,左三段图像显示前三段结果,右三段显示后三段结果. 方法按字母顺序列出:AAMS, AdaAttN, AdaIN, ArtFlow, ChatGPT, NST-Ghiasi, Gatis, LLIP, OmniStyle, SANET, StyTR-2和USO.

blocks.en: Appendix B User Study Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录B 用户研究协议

blocks.en: This section describes the design of the user study and the procedures used to ensure the reliability and consistency of the collected annotations. It first outlines the training phase, which establishes a shared understanding of the evaluation criteria among participants. After introducing the three evaluation criteria, few illustrative examples was presented with unambiguous answers (distinct from the main survey), with further details provided below.It then details the quality control mechanisms applied during the study, including attention checks and fatigue mitigation strategies. Together, these components ensure that the resulting annotations are both interpretable and robust for subsequent analysis.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍用户研究的设计以及用来确保所收集的说明的可靠性和一致性的程序. 报告首先概述了培训阶段,使参与者对评价标准有共同的理解。 在介绍这三项评价标准之后,很少举出说明性的例子,并给出了明确的答复(与主要调查不同),下文将提供进一步的细节。 然后详细介绍研究期间应用的质量控制机制,包括注意检查和疲劳缓解战略。 这些组成部分一起确保由此产生的说明既可解释,又有力,供日后分析。

blocks.en: B.1 Training Phase
blocks.zh: B.1 培训阶段

blocks.en: Before entering the main study, participants completed a mandatory training phase intended to provide a consistent understanding of the evaluation criteria. This phase consisted of an introductory tutorial explaining the key concepts of content , style , and style transfer , supported by both textual descriptions and visual examples.
blocks.zh: 在进入主要研究之前,参与者完成了一个强制性培训阶段,旨在对评价标准提供一致的理解。 这一阶段包括一个介绍性教程,解释内容、风格和风格转移的关键概念,同时辅以文字描述和视觉实例。

blocks.en: Participants were required to complete a set of training questions during this phase. Immediate feedback was provided after each response, and participants were required to answer correctly before proceeding. This process gave each participant a minimum level of understanding prior to the evaluation tasks.
blocks.zh: 在这一阶段,参加者必须完成一系列培训问题。 每次答复后立即提供反馈,要求与会者在进行之前正确回答。 这一过程使每个参与者在完成评价任务之前获得最低限度的理解。

blocks.en: The content of an image refers to the scene being represented, regardless of stylistic rendering, as shown in Fig. 10 . Participants were instructed to consider all scene elements, including both foreground and background components. While stylistic variations (e.g., blur or abstraction) may affect how these elements are depicted, a style should not introduce new semantic objects. Any such deviation was described as reducing content faithfulness.
blocks.zh: 图像的内容是指场景被代表,无论风格渲染,如Fig所示. 10 (英语). 指示与会者考虑所有场景要素,包括前景和背景要素。 虽然结构变化(如模糊或抽象)可能影响这些元素的描绘方式,但风格不应引入新的语义对象. 任何这种偏离都被认为降低了内容的忠诚度。

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Illustration of content consistency: the same scene rendered in different styles.
blocks.zh: 图10:内容一致性图解:以不同风格呈现的相同场景.

blocks.en: The style of an image refers to the artistic characteristics that define its visual appearance, including medium, brushstrokes, texture, and colour usage, as shown in Fig. 11 . Participants were informed that style may include colour, particularly when constrained by the medium (e.g., pen-and-ink). However, in some cases colour may also depend on the underlying content rather than stylistic intent, and should therefore be interpreted with care.
blocks.zh: 图像的风格是指定义其视觉外观的艺术特征,包括介质,刷子,纹理,以及颜色使用,如图11所示. 与会者获悉,风格可能包括颜色,特别是在受介质(如笔墨)制约时。 然而,在某些情况下,颜色还可能取决于基本内容而不是形式意图,因此应谨慎解释。

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Illustration of style consistency: different contents rendered in the same style.
blocks.zh: 图11:风格一致性图示:不同内容以相同风格渲染.

blocks.en: Style transfer was defined as the process of recreating the content of one image using the style of another, as shown in Fig. 12 . Participants were instructed to evaluate stylised results based on how well they balance content preservation and style similarity. In particular, they were encouraged to consider an ideal stylisation that faithfully preserves the content while accurately reflecting the target style. Participants were explicitly advised not to select images solely based on subjective preference, but to judge overall quality as a combination of content and style.
blocks.zh: 样式传输被定义为使用另一个图像的样式重新创建一个图像内容的过程,如Fig所示. 12. 指示与会者根据在内容保存和风格相似性之间如何保持平衡来评价系统化的成果。 特别是鼓励他们考虑一种理想的造型,忠实地保留内容,同时准确反映目标风格. 明确建议与会者不要只根据主观偏好选择图像,而是将整体质量判断为内容和风格的结合.

blocks.en: After introducing the three evaluation dimensions—content preservation, style fidelity, and overall preference—the training phase presents few illustrative examples with clearly distinguishable correct answers, which are distinct from those used in the main survey. For each example, participants are required to make a selection and are immediately provided with feedback indicating whether their choice is correct, along with a brief explanation. Participants must answer each example correctly before proceeding to the next, ensuring that they fully understand the evaluation criteria before entering the main study; examples are shown in Fig. 14 .
blocks.zh: 在介绍三个评价方面——内容保存、风格忠实和总体偏好——之后,培训阶段提供了几个说明性的例子,这些例子显然有正确的答案,与主要调查中使用的答案不同。 就每个例子而言,要求参与者作出选择,并立即得到反馈,表明其选择是否正确,同时作出简要说明。 参与者在进入下一个阶段之前必须正确回答每个例子,确保他们在进入主要研究之前充分了解评价标准;实例见图14。

blocks.en: B.2 Quality Control
blocks.zh: B.2 质量控制

blocks.en: To ensure the reliability of the collected responses, we applied quality control mechanisms during the main study, detailed as follows.
blocks.zh: 为确保所收集答复的可靠性,我们在主要研究期间采用了质量控制机制,详情如下。

blocks.en:
The study included dedicated attention-check trials with predefined correct answers for the content and style dimensions. These trials were interleaved with regular evaluation tasks to identify inattentive participants.
In Stage 1, each participant completed six attention-check trials. A response was considered correct only if both the content and style questions were answered correctly. Participants were included in the analysis only if they answered at least five out of six attention-check trials correctly.
In Stage 2, each participant completed four attention-check trials under the same criteria. Participants were retained only if they answered at least three out of four trials correctly.
blocks.zh:
这项研究包括专门的注意力检查试验,对内容和风格层面有预先确定的正确答案。 这些试验与定期评价任务相互交替,以确定不切实际的参与者。
在第一阶段,每个参与者完成了6次注意力检查试验。 只有内容和风格问题都得到正确回答,答复才被认为是正确的。 只有当参与者正确回答6次注意力检查试验中的至少5次时,才被列入分析。
在第二阶段,每个参与者都根据同样的标准完成了四次注意力检查审判。 只有当参与者对四项审判中至少三项正确回答时,才被保留。

blocks.en: To mitigate fatigue effects in long sessions, we included a mandatory timed break at the midpoint of the study. The break cannot be skipped and the study resumes automatically after a fixed interval, reducing cognitive load accumulation and maintaining response reliability.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻长时间会议中的疲劳效应,我们规定在研究的中点必须有时间间隔。 中断无法跳过,研究在固定间隔后自动恢复,减少认知负载积累,保持响应可靠性.

blocks.en:
After applying the attention-check criteria, 264 of the 407 submitted responses were retained for analysis. To further examine whether the filtering procedure identified low-effort responses, we compared response times between retained and rejected submissions. The median response time per question was 4.526 s for rejected submissions,
compared with 8.573 s for retained submissions. Thus, rejected participants responded in approximately half the time of retained participants, providing additional evidence that the attention-check criteria identified inattentive or low-effort responses.

blocks.en: B.3 Annotation Consistency
blocks.zh: B.3 注释一致性

blocks.en: To quantify the consistency of the collected preference annotations, we randomly selected a subset of comparisons from each stage and obtained duplicate annotations from additional independent annotators. The duplicated comparisons followed the same evaluation protocol as the original study, with annotators independently judging content preservation, style similarity, and overall style-transfer preference.
blocks.zh: 为了量化所收集的首选说明的一致性,我们随机选择了每个阶段的一组比较,并从其他独立注释者那里获得了重复的说明. 重复的比较遵循与原研究相同的评价协议,由注释员独立判断内容保存,风格相似,整体风格转让偏好.

blocks.en: We measured agreement between the original and additional annotations using Cohen’s κ \kappa . For Stage 1, the resulting κ \kappa values were 0.663 for content preservation, 0.547 for style similarity, and 0.547 for overall preference. For Stage 2, the corresponding values were 0.515, 0.389, and 0.416, respectively. The higher agreement observed in Stage 1 is consistent with its controlled design, where both stylised results share the same content-style references. In contrast, Stage 2 requires comparisons across different content-style pairs and therefore involves a more demanding perceptual judgement.
blocks.zh: 我们用科恩的“\kappa”来衡量原始说明和补充说明之间的一致。 对于第一阶段,结果的\kappa值是内容保存0.663,风格相似0.547,总体偏好0.547。 第二阶段的相应数值分别为0.515、0.389和0.416。 第一阶段所观察到的较高一致与其控制设计一致,即两种定型结果共享相同的内容风格参考. 与此相反,第二阶段需要在不同内容类型的对子之间进行比较,因此需要更严格的认知判断。

blocks.en: Overall, these results indicate meaningful but task-dependent annotation consistency despite the subjective nature of style-transfer evaluation. Participants were recruited internationally through online platforms under an approved ethics protocol. The present study was not designed to analyse demographic or cultural differences in perceptual preference; investigating the stability of style-transfer preferences across different cultural or user groups therefore remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果表明,尽管风格转移评价具有主观性,但有实际意义但取决于任务的说明的一致性。 参与者是根据一项核准的道德操守议定书通过在线平台在国际上招聘的。 本研究报告的目的不是分析观念偏好方面的人口或文化差异;因此,调查不同文化或用户群体间风格转让偏好的稳定情况仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en:
Before conducting the user study,

Using natural logarithm, this corresponds to approximately 12 ​ ln ⁡ 12 ≈ 30 12\ln 12\approx 30 comparisons per group for Stage 1 and 864 ​ ln ⁡ 864 ≈ 5.8 × 10 3 864\ln 864\approx 5.8\times 10^{3} comparisons for Stage 2.

光谱排名理论[NOS17,CS15]建议在布拉德利-泰瑞-吕斯[BT52,L*59]等模型下,按照==(n log ⁡n)\Theta(n\log n)比较的顺序进行可靠的排名估计.

blocks.en: These values provided theoretical reference scales rather than exact thresholds, so we further performed simulation analyses under our two-stage design to empirically estimate the number of comparisons needed for stable ranking recovery.
blocks.zh: 这些数值提供了理论参考尺度,而不是精确的阈值,因此,我们进一步在两个阶段的设计下进行了模拟分析,以便实证地估计稳定排序恢复所需的比较数量。

blocks.en:
Stage 1 evaluates style transfer methods under identical content-style conditions.
To estimate the number of comparisons required to obtain reliable method preferences, we simulated pairwise comparison processes assuming the existence of an underlying ground-truth ranking among methods.
Each simulated comparison followed the ground-truth ordering with stochastic noise to account for potential human inconsistency.
The simulated outcomes were aggregated using the Rank Centrality algorithm [ NOS17 ] , a Markov-chain-based estimator for ranking from pairwise comparisons, see more details in Section 4.4 .
Ranking stability was measured using the Spearman correlation [ Spe61 ] between the recovered ranking and the assumed ground-truth ranking.
blocks.zh:

为了估计获得可靠方法偏好所需的比较次数,我们模拟了对等比较过程,假设在方法中存在基本的地面-真实排名。
每一次模拟比较都遵循地面-事实顺序,并带有扭曲的噪音,以说明潜在的人类不一致。
模拟结果采用Rank Centrality算法[NOS17]进行汇总,该算法是Markov-chain基于对等比较的排名估计器,详见第4.4节。
排名稳定性是通过恢复的排名与假定的地面真实排名之间的斯皮尔曼关联[Spe61]测量的.

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 13 , the recovered ranking rapidly stabilises as the number of comparisons increases and exceeds a correlation of ρ = 0.99 \rho=0.99 at approximately 1.2 × 10 4 1.2\times 10^{4} comparisons.
In our actual user study, Stage 1 collected 17,568 votes from 122 participants , which lies well within the regime where the ranking estimation is highly stable.
blocks.zh:
如图13所示,随着比较次数的增加,恢复的排名迅速稳定,在大约1.2×10 4 1.2\times 10==================0.99的相对数中超过了0.99。
在我们的实际用户研究中,第一阶段从122名参与者中收集了17,568张选票,这完全属于排名评估高度稳定的制度。

blocks.en:
While Stage 1 provides reliable rankings within each content-style group, it does not establish relative ordering across different groups.
Stage 2 acquires cross-group comparisons between stylised images belonging to different content-style pairs in order to construct a global ranking across all items.

虽然第一阶段在每个内容类组内提供了可靠的排名,但它并没有在不同组别之间建立相对的顺序.
第2阶段在属于不同内容风格的组合图像之间获得跨组比较,以构建所有项目的全球排名。

blocks.en:
To estimate the number of comparisons required for global ranking, we simulated a synthetic environment in which each item was assigned a latent score determined by method, content, and style effects with additional interaction noise.
The combined comparison data are aggregated using Rank Centrality to estimate the global ranking.

为了估计全球排名所需的比较次数,我们模拟了一个合成环境,在这个环境中,每个物品都根据方法、内容和样式效应得到潜在分数,并增加相互作用噪音。
合并比较数据采用Rank Centrality进行汇总,估计全球排名。

blocks.en: These analyses provide empirical evidence that the scale of our two-stage user study is sufficient to support reliable preference modelling and global ranking estimation.

blocks.en: Appendix D ASTRA Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录D 分析

blocks.en: This section provides additional analyses to validate the reliability of the collected data and to further examine the behavioural patterns underlying human preference. It first analyses the exposure statistics of content and style references across methods to verify that the sampling process is approximately balanced and does not introduce systematic bias. It then extends the investigation of the content–style trade-off by presenting per-style and per-content analyses, offering a more detailed view of how preference patterns vary across different conditions. These analyses provide further evidence supporting the robustness of the benchmark and the style-dependent nature of the observed trade-offs.
blocks.zh: 本节提供额外分析,以验证所收集数据的可靠性,并进一步审查人类偏好背后的行为模式。 它首先分析各种方法中内容和样式参考物的暴露统计数据,以核实取样过程大致平衡,不带来系统性偏差。 然后,它扩展了对内容-风格权衡的调查,提出每类和每类内容的分析,更详细地说明不同条件的偏好模式如何不同。 这些分析提供了进一步的证据,证明基准的稳健性和所观察到的权衡的风格依赖性。

blocks.en: We further investigate the effect of the feature extraction backbone used in ASTRA-Score. We compare architectures from several representative backbone families, including MobileNetV3, VGG, ResNet, ViT, and DINOv2. For all variants, the pretrained backbone is kept frozen and only the task-specific regression heads are trained, such that the comparison primarily reflects the suitability of the extracted representations for modelling human perceptual judgements.

blocks.en: VGG11 achieves the strongest performance across all three evaluation criteria. It obtains Spearman correlations of 0.718 0.718 , 0.714 0.714 , and 0.667 0.667 for content preservation, style similarity, and overall preference, respectively, with corresponding Kendall correlations of 0.540 0.540 , 0.531 0.531 , and 0.492 0.492 . Compared with MobileNetV3, which was also considered as a more compact backbone, VGG11 improves the mean Spearman correlation by 0.032 0.032 , 0.051 0.051 , and 0.043 0.043 for content, style, and overall preference, respectively.
blocks.zh: VGG11在所有三项评价标准中都取得了最强的表现. 它获得了斯皮尔曼的关联性分别为0.718 0.718,0.714 0.714,以及0.667 0.667,分别用于内容保存,风格相似,以及总体偏好,相应的肯德尔关联性分别为0.540 0.540,0.531 0.531,0.492 0.492. 与也被认为是比较紧凑的主干线的MobileNetV3相比,VGG11将平均Spearman的关联性分别提高了0.032 0.032,0.0510.051,在内容,风格和总体偏好方面分别提高了0.043 0.043.

blocks.en: Increasing backbone capacity does not consistently improve alignment with human judgements. In particular, VGG19 performs below VGG11 across all three criteria, while ResNet50 is competitive for style similarity but remains weaker for content preservation and overall preference. The transformer-based ViT-B/16 and DINOv2 variants likewise do not provide consistent improvements over VGG11. These results indicate that the choice of backbone has a non-negligible effect on perceptual evaluation performance, and motivate our use of VGG11 as the default feature extractor for ASTRA-Score.
blocks.zh: 骨干能力的提高并没有一贯改善与人类判断的一致性。 尤其是,VGG19在所有三项标准中都表现在VGG11以下,而ResNet50在风格相似性上具有竞争力,但在内容保存和总体偏好上仍然较弱. 基于变压器的VIT-B/16和DINOv2变体同样不能提供比VGG11一致的改进. 这些结果表明,骨干的选择对知觉评价性能有不可忽略的影响,并激励我们使用VGG11作为ASTRA-Score的默认特性提取器.
